<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market surge:</strong> The Sensex jumped over 1,500 points and the Nifty rallied significantly, driven by strong performance in IT and banking stocks alongside a recovery in the rupee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory updates:</strong> SEBI has proposed a major overhaul of SME IPO rules, including a reduction in minimum investment requirements, while also reviewing F&amp;O expiry and trading hour frameworks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPWmdLYTVKXzBadEVEenhHajlDb1AwYnRNeXQtQnhPQWNjenNFVDZBVW03cFJROGVUeGhJMUl3eXI5bk5DckV2WFowc0gySExRQWRVS1RVTHZ5N0ExVFpHN29IYnNLWlVCejdHbi1nQkROMFpBdjZ0a1Zlb2pHMTNrQjh3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and commodity dynamics:</strong> The Indian rupee strengthened to 94.86 against the dollar, supported by RBI interventions and a decline in Brent crude prices below $105 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOQmw2enVib0FBSGxxa2gtOTZyakJNMzJpcXh3cXlPQmt4RnVsQVBHNF9DaEV5Y0ZfMDNadzV0RzlYaWpsSUhsZ2tzU1BmZVg4cFJYQTlTeTcxSnV6dHNndWg4T3ZHRXdLVkpfbjlQRW1UUGY2UDZzMDJDV1dLbjFvX0lIREc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
